[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (numbers: List Int) : Bool :=
let rec loop (seen: Set Int) (i: Nat) : Bool :=
  if i = numbers.length then
    false
  else
    let num := numbers[i]!
    if num = 0 then
      true
    else if seen.contains (-num) then
      true
    else
      loop (seen.insert num) (i + 1)
loop Set.empty 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
-- No helper lemmas needed for this implementation.
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation numbers
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_seen := loop seen i
  have h_seen_true := h_seen
  by_cases h_seen_true: h_seen = true
  -- Case 1: h_seen = true
  simp [h_seen_true]
  apply Iff.intro
  -- forward direction
  apply And.intro
  -- exists_zero exists
  exact ⟨i, i, h_seen_true, by simp, by simp⟩
  -- backward direction
  simp [h_seen_true]
